The '''Institute of Government Service''' was located on [[New Apsolon/Legends|New Apsolon]] in the [[Civilized sector]]. It contained [[Roan's office]] and the [[Secret meeting room]] where [[Balog (Human)|Balog]] kidnapped [[Tahl]].
